reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "7edaef54d456a9f5f59760f0bb4958e41a43fd94: feat(helm): upgrading helm to 3.17.0", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Helm chart operations (templating/rendering of Helm-based applications) are now performed with Helm 3.17.0 instead of the previously bundled Helm version, so chart processing behavior follows Helm 3.17.0.
consequence.remediation: Review Helm 3.17.0 release changes and verify Helm-based applications still render and deploy as expected after the upgrade.

proposed.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 upgrades its bundled Helm to 3.17.0, so Helm chart operations now run on Helm 3.17.0.
